extraction.Name: Louise Bordeaux (Jarboe)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by the Lyman Abstract Company June 5, 1926
extraction.Buyer: Louise Bordeaux Jabboe and husband conveyed the land to Joseph Hoon and Cora Hoon for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612685 issued; Northeast quarter of Section 7, township 37, north of range 25; deed dated May 5, 1926; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee
